CVE-2026-105454.title: Stored XSS via crafted URLs in HTML ticket content in Request Tracker
CVE-2026-105454.description:
RT's automatic link creation for URLs in HTML ticket content does
not HTML-escape the URL it places in the link. A URL crafted to
break out of the link's address can add a script that runs when the
ticket history is displayed, with no further action by the viewer.
Anyone who can add HTML content to a ticket can plant it. That
includes an unauthenticated sender of HTML email to any queue that
grants CreateTicket or ReplyToTicket to Everyone, which is routine
for a queue that accepts mail from the public. The script runs in
the session of any user who views the ticket, and can act in RT
with that user's authority.

CVE-2026-61916.title: Apache bRPC: Out-of-bounds Read in URL and Header Lookup Tables on Unsigned-char Platforms
CVE-2026-61916.description:
Out-of-bounds reads in URL parsing and case-insensitive header lookup in Apache bRPC before version 1.18.0 on platforms where plain char is unsigned, such as ARM64, allow remote attackers to cause a process crash and denial of service by sending crafted input containing bytes with the high bit set.

Root Cause:
Two 256-entry lookup tables are accessed through pointers biased by 128 so that valid indices are in the range -128 to 127. Input bytes are promoted from plain char to int without first normalizing them to the signed-char range. On affected platforms, bytes in the range 0x80 to 0xFF therefore become indices 128 to 255 and read up to 127 bytes beyond the end of the underlying tables.

CVE-2026-62250.description: LibreDWG is a free C library to read and write DWG files. CVE-2026-87039.description:

CVE-2026-99119.title: drm/amdgpu/userq: actually validate userq BOs
CVE-2026-99119.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

drm/amdgpu/userq: actually validate userq BOs

This was supposed to loop over the individual evicted list, as the
kernel and always_valid evicted lists were already handled in
amdgpu_vm_validate.

Without this, BOs that were created and evicted before a userq was made
would never end up in an eviction fence rearm.

Also add the missing ref to the BO before drm_exec locks and refs it.
